status: Descriptive design data with a vanilla interaction reference; not a packaged component API.

space.unit: CSS-pixel-equivalent; adapt to native units and user scaling

motion.reducedMotion: Remove decorative motion; preserve stable progress and status information.

contrast.method: Standard sRGB relative luminance for opaque colors and conservative gradient endpoints; compare unrounded ratios.
contrast.foregroundOnAccent: Below 4.5:1 before rounding; do not use for normal text requiring 4.5:1.
contrast.actionLabelTarget: At least 5:1 on both gradient endpoints and hover/pressed.

compartments.reset: Width and collapse only; preserve other display preferences.

effects.rule: Decorative edge only; no grid or glow behind text.

material.scope: Revision 3 subtle skeuomorphism; structural panels and controls only. Table content remains flat and opaque.
material.pressed: Solid gradient bottom with shallow inset shadow; no movement.
material.disabled: Solid surface, muted label, dashed border, no relief or opacity fading.
material.field: Solid surface and shallow inset shadow; native control appearance retained.
material.focus: Independent 3px outline with 3px offset; never an error indicator.
material.forcedColors: Remove gradients and shadows; use native system colors and visible outlines.
material.effects: Decorative edge preference remains independent of material depth.
